title: What If Schools Banned Phones? The Dutch Did and Checked

scenes.text: What if every classroom banned smartphones? The Netherlands did, then measured the result.
Since January 2024, national guidelines have kept phones out of Dutch classrooms.
The government asked 317 high schools what changed. About three quarters said students concentrate better.
Nearly two thirds reported a better social climate, with more students talking to each other.
And about one in three schools saw better grades.
In primary schools almost nothing changed, because children that young rarely bring phones.

description:
What if schools banned phones in class?
The Netherlands did in 2024, and a government-commissioned survey of 317 high schools found better focus and a better social climate.
